topic.source_contract: NSIP threshold, pre-application consultation, application documents, acceptance, examination, recommendation, decision, DCO requirements, land rights, implementation and operational evidence

scope_guards: A proposed NSIP is not treated as an accepted application.
An accepted application is not treated as a recommendation or consent.
An examination recommendation is not treated as the Secretary of State decision.
A made DCO is not treated as all requirements discharged.
A compulsory acquisition power is not treated as acquired land.
A certified plan is not treated as constructed works.
A commencement notice is not treated as operational infrastructure.
No score or promotion is written without exact order, requirements, land rights, construction, commissioning and operational evidence.
